messages:
alex: Heads-up — Tamarack VPC cutover scheduled Sat 02:00–04:00 UTC. Who can take which tasks? I'll post the minimal checklist and runbook links here.

maría: I can do smoke checks and verify app-level probes + logs.

simon: I'll own rollback readiness: DB snapshot + rollback scripts. I'll be reachable on my phone.

tara: I'll coordinate calendar invites and customer POC comms. tagging infra oncall @kim — need LB switchover help.

devops-bot: maintenance window created: https://console.internal/maint/3400123456 — reminder scheduled 30m before start.

kim: available 01:30–05:00 UTC, I can handle LB switchover and route updates. Please send exact endpoints to flip. :thumbsup:

alex: Plan (high level):
1) 02:00 — start change window, drain non-critical traffic
2) 02:05 — apply config + infra changes (LB, route table)
3) 02:15 — restart inference services in canary pool
4) 02:20 — run smoke tests (service-level)
5) 02:30 — run load validation / small synthetic workload + sampling checks
6) 02:45 — promote traffic to new VPC
7) 03:00–04:00 — monitor, rollback if errors >5% or latency regresses.

Rollback plan (short): revert route table and LB changes, restore DB snapshot if needed, redeploy previous model revision tag. Simon will run /scripts/rollback_tamarack.sh if triggered.

maría: For smoke tests, propose:
- 02:20: run quick health check (200s) across 5 endpoints
- 02:25: run sample generation set (10 prompts) and compare token counts/latency

snippet of smoke command to run on jumpbox:
```
./smoke.sh --env tamarack --endpoints /api/generate,/api/health --samples smoke_set_v3.json
```

simon: I'll have snapshots and rollback scripts prepped by 18:00 today. I'll also add a dry-run flag to the script for validation.

tara: Sending calendar invite to internal ops + customer POC now. Customer asked for an ETA on validation — we'll tell them 02:45 for traffic promotion unless blocked.

alex: One ask: keep verbose logs for at least 24h and upload to the change doc if anything is >5% error. Add a note on the runbook about model-version pinned during cutover.

kim: Please DM me the exact LB hostnames to update and the BGP route snippet if we need to adjust.

maría: I'll post the smoke results table in this thread after 02:25. If anything looks off I'll @alex and @simon immediately.

alex: Great — when you've completed preflight, react with :white_check_mark:. If anyone needs me earlier, ping. Thanks all.

simon: :white_check_mark: preflight scripts validated locally, will push to /ops/artifacts tonight.

tara: :white_check_mark: calendar + customer notified.

maría: :white_check_mark: will be on call for smoke checks.

kim: :white_check_mark: set up and will be present for LB work.
